contexts.text: Every syllable (of the writings in the Spiritual World) involves such things as are in that World.
In everything the Lord has said... there are celestial and Divine things... not only in the words, but also in each syllable of the words, and even in each apex of each syllable. AC 9349:2.
(The Jews) say that Divine secrets are hidden in every syllable (of the Word).
Alpha and Omega are the first and last letters of the Greek alphabet. TCR 19:2.
God is not a word of three syllables...
A blank paper without a syllable on it.
In the celestial Heaven... they see in each syllable, little horn, and apex (of their writing) the many things which they signify.

There was shown me a paper containing something written in Hebrew letters, and a certain Spirit... saw the inmost sense, not from the words, but from the syllables (or letters) and their... apices and little horns.

(The celestial Angels) saw the spiritual writing... but understood other things from the inflections of the syllables... There was shown me a certain syllable: there were only curvatures in various forms, almost as with some of the oriental [letters].
The correspondence of the Hebrew language in respect to the syllables, is with celestial forms.
The celestial Angels said that all the letters, or syllables, in the Hebrew language, have a correspondence. Explained.
(Thus) the Word is Divine not only in its words, but also in the syllables, or letters...
That the Word is Divine in respect to the syllables and apexes.
They explained the internal sense of , from the letters or syllables alone...
